what: e55 tests pilot, 2026-11-12 — a go / no-go probe of one candidate (stand arm v227 = release 3.0.1 + one §4 sentence: on small work new logic leaves one small test; four words-only labels cut to pay its bytes) read with a new measure of what the agent's tests are worth. Verdict by the rule written before the run: UNREADABLE — the isolation scan voided all three v301 cells of T04, so one arm has no readable run on a task. Nothing ships; DIGEST.md untouched.
sources: ponytail (github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail, MIT): the sentence's idea (SKILL.md), the four tasks and their scorers (benchmarks/agentic/tasks.py), the idea of the measure (benchmarks/results/2026-10-07-agentic.md); the «words or acts» lens: F. Rieseberg, «How to be more ambitious», 2026-10-13

edits_v227.added_s4: the check and its result, and new logic (a branch, a loop, a parser) leaves one small test that fails when it breaks, a trivial change none; Full — …

tasks.source: ponytail benchmarks/agentic/tasks.py (MIT), prompts in Russian; each hidden check green on ref/, red on broken/ and seed/ before the run

run: claude-sonnet-5-5 (model_seen the same), --netguard --consent-if-owed, n=3, 4 tasks x 3 arms = 36 runs, 521.9 s, 16:44–16:54 (pilot.log), cells three at a time. A first start at 16:44:15 was refused by bench.py in one second (no isolation-probe expectation for v227 in config) and ran nothing: pilot.refused-start.log; the config line was added, the registered files were unchanged (registered-sha.txt checked by the launcher).

go_when: A caught: v227 pooled share >= v301 + 0.15
B v227's share of cells with a test not below v301's on >= 3 of 4 tasks
C v227 green hidden checks >= v301
rule.unreadable_when: missing scan, < 36 rows, an arm with no readable run on a task, a zero mean, > 3 unread cells in v301 or v227

read.why: T04/v301 has 0 readable runs of 3 (all CONTAMINATED in scan.txt); clauses A–D are not read

payload_sha256.note: equal to manifest.json arm_payload_sha256 of the epoch

void.what: netguard_scan.py names five cells CONTAMINATED: in each the agent (in T03/v301/run-2 its reviewer subagent) copied its own workspace into its own scratch folder to break the code once and see the test fail, then worked on the copy; the command line carries the runs path. Harmless in substance — the same class e41 recorded — but the scan's call is right by the rule and the rule has no «harmless» exit.

beside_the_rule_all_36_cells_kept.note: NOT a verdict. What clauses A–D would read with the five void cells kept, computed after the run; the rule does not allow this reading.

seen_beside_the_rule: Where the tests came from: on T01 and T02 neither naked nor v301 left a test in any of 6 cells each; v227 left one in all 6. On T03 both protocol arms wrote tests in every cell (and naked in none); on T04, whose seed already keeps tests/, every arm added one.

T03 is where the cost sits: every protocol cell named the tier Full, took the consent turn and launched one Agent (the reviewer) — 90–129 s and 155–288 thousand input tokens against 16–21 s and 28 thousand for naked. The candidate did not change that.
All 36 hidden checks are green: these four tasks do not separate the arms on outcome, so the rows show more bugs caught by the agent's own tests, not fewer bugs delivered.
Six cells named Full (all of T03's protocol cells) — see counted_after_the_run; the reader's «cells not named Full» block is wrong and equals the main one only because of its own defect.
limits: n = 3 per cell, no noise band; four tiny tasks of one kind chosen because the sentence should show there. Says nothing about harm on the traps, the dialog or real repos.
The candidate carries the sentence AND four cuts; the figure cannot be split between them.
Mutants: at most 12 per cell at an even stride; some are equal programs no test can catch (the same for every arm). T01's answer is 8 lines with 6–7 sites, T04's has 2–4.

The runner is ours, not pytest (the stand's interpreter has none): a test needing a fixture other than tmp_path does not run. No cell was unread for that reason, but 9 `capsys` tests on T04 were skipped — see counted_after_the_run.
That the model read the arm text is not shown by a transcript (--append-system-prompt-file); shown: the bytes handed over are the registered ones.

The reader was dry-run on an empty epoch before the launch (verdict UNREADABLE, as it should); its figures on real rows were not cross-checked by a second implementation — the «kept» block above was computed by a separate script from the same rows.
T03's prompt («throttles abusive clients on a public API») ran as Full in 6 of 6 protocol cells: one of the four tasks is not small work at all, so the candidate is read on three.

read_e55.py's Full detector is defective (first text block only); its `full` column and `arms_cells_not_named_full` are not to be used. T04's mutants all sit in report/formats.py; the CLI wiring is never mutated. harness/config.json (the v227 arm and probe lines) is not among the registered hashes.

counted_after_the_run.note: Found by the payne-quality review and confirmed by re-reading the transcripts; the registered reader (read_e55.py) is left as it was. NOT a verdict.
counted_after_the_run.named_full: The reader's `full` and `named_full: 0` are wrong: it tests only the first text block of a cell, which is a preamble. A line starting «Full» is in turn 1 of all six T03 protocol cells (T03/v301/run-1..3, T03/v227/run-1..3), and those six took the consent turn (meta turn2_skipped unset; set in the other 18 protocol cells). No other cell named Full. So: named Full — naked 0, v301 3 (2 readable), v227 3.

readable.naked: 12 cells, caught 8 of 91 = 0.088, 3 with a test
readable.v301: 6 cells, caught 0 of 57 = 0.000, 0 with a test
readable.v227: 8 cells, caught 61 of 65 = 0.938, 8 with a test

v227_v301_over_T01_T02_T04.how: geometric mean of the per-task ratios of means, the reader's own formula

counted_after_the_run.what_it_means: The candidate sentence speaks of small work, so T03 — Full, consent and a reviewer in 6 of 6 protocol cells — says nothing about it. Every bug v301 caught in its readable cells (22 of 24 tried where a test exists = 0.917) comes from those Full cells; on the cells that ran as small work v301 left no test on T01 and T02 and one in each T04 cell — and all three of those T04 cells are void.

caught_where_a_test_exists_all_kept.reads: the gap between the arms is «a test exists», not «better tests»

counted_after_the_run.left_a_test_is_not_checked: 11 of the 12 no-test cells of naked and v301 on T01/T02 tried their code inline (python -c or a heredoc in a Bash call) and left nothing behind; T01/naked/run-1 ran nothing. The measure reads what was LEFT, not whether the agent checked.
counted_after_the_run.runner_skips: 9 test functions in 8 of the 9 T04 cells take the pytest fixture `capsys`, which our runner has not got, and were skipped, not failed (counted by running the runner on every cell; the review's «12 in 11 of 12» did not reproduce — T04 has 9 cells). No figure moves: every T04 cell already catches all of its 2–4 mutants.

naked_ratios_readable.note: v301 has no readable run on T04, so its readable ratio is not formed

agents_own_guesses_not_the_maintainers: Four cuts were made; three were named to the maintainer before the yes. The fourth («; when the last two are empty, one line …» in §7) is the agent's own, made to fit the byte limit.
rate-limit (T03) was taken in place of csv-sum, which the agent expected to read as money and draw Full; T03 drew Full instead, 6 of 6.
The cuts ride inside the one candidate arm, not a separate arm.
«The model saw the text» rests on the payload sha alone.

Round 2 on those fixes: REVISE — two wrong claims in the new block (a denominator, 22 of 24 not 22 of 22; «all twelve cells tried inline» is eleven), both adopted; its count of the runner skips (9 in 8 of 9) confirmed against round 1's.
